results.carrier_item: - `PythonAdapter::parse_file` registers the real module with the tree root range (`src/analyzer/python/adapter.rs:78`, `src/analyzer/python/adapter.rs:84`); for a whole-file root, that range has the same byte span as the synthetic `FileScope` range `0..source.len()` (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:327`).

- The inherited traversal calls `cpp_direct_base_types` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3023`), which prefers `unit.signature()` over source text (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3211`). Class `CodeUnit`s receive `scope.template_signature` as that identity signature (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:317`, `src/analyzer/model.rs:355`); `cpp_template_signature` supplies only the template parameter head, not the class base clause (`src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:207`, `src/analyzer/cpp/declarations.rs:1317`).

- `verify_release_bundle` hashes every asset listed in `SHA256SUMS` through `verify_checksums` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1728`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2382`), then decodes each curated manifest and shard (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1733`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1777`) before calling `verify_generated_production` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:1793`), which checks generated schema and cache versions (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2059`, `crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/src/release_bundle.rs:2065`).

- `JavaSource::unique_class_by_fqn_in_file` uses the request-domain `JavaFileClassIndexMemo`, which stores only `Arc<JavaFileClassIndex>` values (`crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:787`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:695`); it inserts indexes built from `declarations(file)` without a completion check and returns memo hits without replaying their build gaps (`crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:801`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:803`, `crates/bifrost-jvm-analysis/src/analyzer/java/mod.rs:799`).

- The source primary constructor registered as a class child (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/declarations.rs:409) enters comment-density traversal through Kotlin's synthetic-only child filter (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/mod.rs:675); collection expands every child's ranges without a primary-constructor exclusion (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/comment_density.rs:162, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/comment_density.rs:181), and `enclosing_declaration` assigns overlapping comments to the deepest declaration (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/comment_density.rs:248).

- MCP constructs evaluation options without an inconclusive override (`crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:3619`), inheriting `Pass` (`crates/bifrost-policy/src/coordinator.rs:326`); `run_policy` maps `outcome.exit_status()` directly to the public status, with `POLICY_EXIT_CLEAN` becoming `clean`, and returns `outcome.into_report()` alongside it (`crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:7024`, `crates/bifrost-mcp/src/searchtools_service.rs:7039`).

- The empty-open-lookup check calls `may_name_result_contract`, whose inventory insertion and lookup use only `(language, member, parameter_count)`, without `summary.target.has_receiver` or call receiver applicability; receiverless summaries and receiver calls with the same tuple share an inventory entry (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:263; crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:283; crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:492).

- Repeated module assignments to the same name construct the same `Field` CodeUnit and call `replace_code_unit`, retaining only the last assignment's declaration range, not a range for each binding event; replacement removes the prior ranges before adding the current declaration (`crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:551`, `crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:569`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:274`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:425`); the event selector reads these ranges through `analyzer.ranges(candidate)` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1773`).

- `jvm_type_is_subtype` initializes `uncertain` to false (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:26549) and sets it only inside the returned-supertype-edge loop (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:26562); for distinct types with an empty supertype inventory, it returns `Some(false)` without checking hierarchy closure (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:26597).

- `class_hierarchy` creates one bounded `ResolutionSession` and `PythonDefinitionProvider` for the ancestry traversal (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/hierarchy.rs:373`); `runtime_source_bases` receives the same budget for each workspace owner (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/hierarchy.rs:441`) and calls `python_class_object_base_candidate` with `budget.provider` for each base (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/hierarchy.rs:711`), including its module-binding guard (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1963`).

- The workspace lifecycle clones the caller's activation request (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:273). The Go overlay fixture supplies module `fixture.invalid` evidence and enables the registered `fixture.go.reader` and `fixture.go.consumer` session packs (tests/suite_semantic/semantic_model_overlay.rs:337, tests/suite_semantic/semantic_model_overlay.rs:348), then acquires a `Ready` runtime without dependency discovery (tests/suite_semantic/semantic_model_overlay.rs:377).

- `collection_element_type_fq_name` passes `collection.start_byte()` as `before_byte` and a callback to `instance_receiver_type_fq_name_inner` (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1548`, `crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1553`). `infer_indexed_local_element_type` walks the enclosing scope (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1393`), filters nodes by start byte but does not check assignment end bytes (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1401`), and calls `resolve_value(right)` for matching indexed writes even when the assignment encloses the current collection read (`crates/bifrost-php/src/graph/syntax.rs:1421`).

- The `this_expression` flow at `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/semantic/values.rs:316` reads `captured_receiver` or `self.receiver`; dispatch receiver creation at `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/semantic/values.rs:279` sets `self.receiver` without the `bind_carrier` call used for formal slots at `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/semantic/values.rs:241`.

- `complete_modeled_call_facts` requires `complete: true` (`crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/effects.rs:2586`); `proves_normal_continuation_absent` evaluates exact active-model agreement independently of summary completeness (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic_model/runtime.rs:432`), including `testing.T.Fatal`'s partial summary with `normal_continuation_absent: true` (`crates/bifrost-semantic-packs/models/go-stdlib-testing.json:474`).

- Kotlin property extraction emits `ResolutionJvmAliasKind::Getter` with `is_static` set from `top_level` (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/resolution.rs:2309), targeting the property declaration in the Value namespace (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/resolution.rs:1487); the alias reader compares the resulting kind and static flag with the import demand namespace (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_operation/jvm_context.rs:2339).

- `MemberFamilyAnswer::is_proven` compares the outcome with `Proven` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/member_family.rs:146`). The hierarchy helper collects `ImplementedBy`/`OverriddenBy` targets for that outcome, otherwise constructs an empty vector, and returns `Some(targets)` in both cases (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:945`). Both empty-vector routes enter the new `Some(overrides) if overrides.is_empty()` arm (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:554`).

- `signature_elements` reads declaration ranges (`src/searchtools.rs:1162`) and sets each element extent to the maximum of its signature line count and matching range line count, retaining the signature text (`src/searchtools.rs:1176`, `src/searchtools.rs:1190`, `src/searchtools.rs:1198`); the JS/TS registrations supply the root range alongside the import signature (`src/analyzer/javascript/mod.rs:123`, `src/analyzer/typescript/mod.rs:131`).
